answer: The quill cap is applied at intake and grove exposes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a willow tag. That is 27 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
